item.description:
First public release of powerNotch, an independent fork of boringNotch.
- Music playback controls, artwork and synchronized lyrics in the notch or Dynamic Island. - Experimental native NetEase Cloud Music support. - Per-display Notch / Dynamic Island modes and configurable Liquid Glass appearance. - Optional AI quota, balance and usage-history monitoring. - Calendar, reminders, file shelf, system HUDs and webcam tools inherited from boringNotch.
Requires macOS 15 Sequoia or later; native Liquid Glass requires macOS 26 or later. The DMG supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
The app is not notarized by Apple. After installing it in Applications and trying to launch it, you may need to allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. Desktop widget data sharing is unavailable in this ad-hoc build; AI usage inside the app remains available.
Full credit to TheBoredTeam and boringNotch contributors, and the other projects acknowledged in the README and third-party notices.
